ledger.note: 1380: Ampu Jatmika founds Negara Dipa at Amuntai. He 'founded the kingdom of Negara Dipa in 1380 or 1387' and built Candi Agung over an older site in Amuntai; the area was Nan Sarunai's. The majapahit dossier is the counterpart of the land (the third Majapahit invasion launched 1355 'led by Ampu Jatmika', battles 1358 and 1362).

1478: Sekarsungsang moves the capital and the kingdom becomes Negara Daha. Raden Sekarsungsang (Maharaja Sari Kaburangan, 1478-1486) 'moved the capital from Amuntai to Muara Hulak, with its port at Muara Bahan. The kingdom then became known as Negara Daha.' Same state, same colour (rule 2).
1478: the capital moves from Amuntai to Muara Hulak (port Muara Bahan).

The page lists Sewa Agung, Bunyut, Karasikan, Balitung, Lawai and Kotawaringin as Negara Daha's territory without dates; the year is the reign start of Sekarsungsang and the shape is the sultanate-of-banjar dossier's reading of the land (a gap).

ledger.note: 1526: Raden Samudra's Banjar replaces Negara Daha. The succession dispute after Maharaja Sukarama (1486-1520) and Maharaja Tumenggung (1520-1526) sent Prince Samudera to found a kingdom in Banjar Masih and win Demak's help; the sultanate-of-banjar dossier dates Samudra's conversion and accession to 24 September 1526 (the Daha page gives no date for these events; confidence lowered to 2 by the se-02-x review: the year is the end of Maharaja Tumenggung's reign, 1520-1526, not a dated end of Daha).

ledger.note: 1526: Negara Daha ends in the Banjar Sultanate. Maharaja Tumenggung ruled 1520-1526; the Dipa page names Negara Dipa 'the predecessor of Negara Daha and Banjar Sultanate'.

wars.name: Daha succession war and Demak's intervention
wars.outcome: Prince Samudera, who fled after the succession dispute, 'sought help from the Demak Sultanate' and 'regained the throne and established the Banjar kingdom'.
wars.note: The page gives no date for the war or for Demak's help; Tumenggung's reign (1520-1526) bounds it.

notes: One state under two names: Negara Dipa (1380 or 1387 to 1477) and Negara Daha (1478 to 1526), the second being the page's name after Sekarsungsang's move; the sultanate-of-banjar dossier uses the slug negara-daha. The Daha page has no end date and no infobox; 1526 is the Banjar dossier's start. The rulers before 1478 (Ampu Jatmika, Lambung Mangkurat) have no reign years on the Dipa page. Wikidata id not looked up (wikidata.org unreachable): null. The gap between Nan Sarunai's fall (1362) and Dipa's founding (1380 or 1387) is not explained on either page; the 'majapahit' counterpart is the researcher's reading (confidence 2), since the Dipa page ties Ampu Jatmika to the Majapahit invasion.
